precondition.description: For an already selected and authorized provider-local change, SDSS has no prior guard record or its provider-owned delivery, refusal, and receipt evidence digest differs from the predecessor record.

postcondition.description: Provider-local evidence, analysis gaps, one selected plan, actual execution disposition, protected invariants, predecessor, and next observation basis are append-only. Unchanged evidence is refused. This record neither supplies the campaign's Union-wide Monitor nor proves RSI or customer value.
